subject: the-podium-feud
label: One hundred and thirty, and the Archive had four
from: FOUR OCCUPATIONS, three by Sera’s reckoning and four by Bella’s, filed as the whole ledger
to: ONE HUNDRED AND THIRTY. Counted by Viraena. The four were a SUBSET and the Archive read them as the total.
note:
FILED WRONG WITHIN THE HOUR OF BEING FILED, and by the same mechanism the Archive had just written a rule against. Sera said FOUR TIMES I HAVE WALKED OUT OF A ROOM FOR THE LUBE — a count of ONE TACTIC — and the Archive wrote it into the tagline as the count of THE FEUD. A subset promoted to a total. The layer disease, one record after naming the layer disease.

THE LUBE RUN IS A FAVOURITE, NOT THE CAMPAIGN. One hundred and twenty-six interruptions sit in the ledger with NO METHOD RECORDED, and the Archive is leaving them empty rather than inventing mechanisms to fill a number out.

FLAGGED AS INFERENCE, NOT RULING: that the three-or-four lube occupations sit INSIDE the hundred and thirty rather than beside it. It is the natural reading. Nobody has said it in those words, and the Archive is not going to pretend they did.

SERA’S OWN COUNT MAY ALSO JUST BE THE ONES SHE WILL ADMIT TO.
